subject: Intro: NimbleRx x AWS co-sell alignment — kickoff & JAP items
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@nimblerx.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@amazon.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: NimbleRx x AWS co-sell alignment — kickoff & JAP items

Hi Lara and Tom —

Thanks for taking the time last week to say hello. Per our call, I wanted to introduce the core team and get a short kickoff scheduled to align on goals and a draft joint account plan (JAP). High-level ask: coordinate an intro call that covers solution fit, procurement runway, and a short technical checklist so we can scope a marketplace listing + co-sell motion.

Who I've looped in: Karthik (Sales lead) and Lauren (Solutions/PS ops).

Proposed 45-min agenda:
- Intros & objectives (5 min)
- High-level architecture + data flows (10 min)
- Marketplace listing & procurement checklist (10 min)
- Joint account plan milestones / next 30/90 days (10 min)
- Action items & owners (10 min)

Proposed times (PST):
- Wed Feb 4, 10:00-10:45
- Thu Feb 5, 14:00-14:45

A couple of things we want to capture in the JAP: target ACV expectations, procurement contact and timeline, required security artifacts (SOC2, data retention), and go-to-market co-sell touchpoints. I can draft a JAP doc and share before the call — would you prefer Google Drive or a Word doc?

Thanks — Hannah
--
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@amazon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@nimblerx.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Feb 2026 11:03:21 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: NimbleRx x AWS co-sell alignment — kickoff & JAP items

Hi Hannah / Lara —

Thanks for the intro, Hannah. Wed Feb 4 at 10:00 PST works for me and I’ll loop in Asha (Marketplace SA) to cover listing and procurement nuances.

Quick notes from the AWS side we typically want included up front:
- Target regions and account structure for listing (single account vs consolidated billing)
- Expected CVE/patch cadence and who will own updates for the listing
- Procurement contract preference (SOW vs Marketplace SaaS contract)
- Any compliance gating (SOC 2 report availability or in-flight)

Asha — if you can share the marketplace checklist we use, that’ll help Hannah prepare the JAP draft.

See you tomorrow 10:00 PST.

Tom
Tom Alvarez
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
tom.alvarez@amazon.com

From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@nimblerx.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Feb 2026 08:47:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: NimbleRx x AWS co-sell alignment — kickoff & JAP items

Hi Hannah / Tom —

Thanks, the times both work. Let’s lock Wed Feb 4 at 10:00 PST. I do have a few procurement/security asks before we meet so we can be efficient: 

1) Do you have a short procurement checklist (PO vs marketplace billing options) and expected contract lead time?
2) We require SOC 2 Type II or AICPA equivalent — are you able to provide the report or a remediation plan if it’s in progress?
3) For SSO and data residency: we prefer SAML SSO and EU data residency for some PHI-adjacent workloads — is that supported on the current architecture?

Also attaching our standard NDA for signatures (we can sign yours if you prefer). Can you share the JAP template and any marketplace listing checklist prior to the call?

Best —
Lara Chen
Head of IT & Security
NimbleRx
lara.chen@nimblerx.com
Attachment: NimbleRx_NDA_for_partner_review.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@nimblerx.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@amazon.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: NimbleRx x AWS co-sell alignment — kickoff & JAP items

Lara / Tom —

Great call last week — thanks for the time. Per action items I’m attaching our draft JAP (NimbleRx_JAP_v1.0.docx) and the signed NDA (NDA_NimbleRx_signed.pdf). Key asks from our side before the next sync: 

- Procurement contact at NimbleRx (name + email) and preferred billing path (AWS Marketplace SaaS or direct PO).
- Confirmation that SOC 2 Type II report is available or estimated completion date. If in-progress, please share the scope and expected remediation timeline.
- For data residency: we propose a hybrid approach initially (EU region for PHI-adjacent data, US for non-sensitive logs). Please confirm feasibility and any additional cost implications.

Next steps proposed:
- Tue Feb 17, 10:00-11:00 PST — JAP review (30 min) + procurement handoff (30 min) — invite to follow once procurement contact provided.

Tom / Asha: can you share the AWS marketplace listing checklist and a short note on typical time-to-live for a SaaS listing (from submission to publish)? That will help set the procurement runway.

Thanks — Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (650) 555-0134
